theme: Light and Dark mode supported. Default: Light. Theming logic must support seamless switching.

typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk (Weights: 500 Medium, 700 Bold). Used for page titles, panel headers, and empty state CTAs. Tracking-tight.
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans (Weights: 400 Regular, 500 Medium). Used for all data tables, numbers, forms, and general UI. Excellent legibility for accounting.
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono (Weights: 400, 500). Used for MXIK codes, Soliq IDs, API keys, and AI JSON tool calls.

colors.archetype: SWISS FINANCIAL (Archetype 4) merged with ORGANIC TRUST (Archetype 1)
colors.rules: FORBIDDEN: Purple/Violet gradients on white (AI slop). DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds over content.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp borders. Use border-collapse for tables. Grid items must have explicit borders separating them, creating a technical ledger feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for interactive cards on hover. Mostly rely on borders for hierarchy.
visual_enhancers.radius: radius-sm (4px) or radius-none. Sharp, professional, structural. No pill-shaped buttons for tables, only for primary global CTAs.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for the sticky top-nav and the AI chat floating panel. Light: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b. Dark: bg-[#09090B]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b.

layouts.app_shell: Persistent left sidebar (Navigation) + Sticky Top Bar (Company Switcher + User Profile).
layouts.sidebar: Darker shade than background in Light Mode (#F4F4F5). Contains Lucide icons + text. Collapsible on mobile.
layouts.top_bar: Contains the Multi-Company Switcher. This is the global context. Changing company here changes the data everywhere.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Protocol Mode B: High Density. gap-4. Metric cards (col-span-1), Main Chart (col-span-2 or 3).
layouts.empty_state_critical: Onboarding Empty State (0 Companies): User logs in and sees NO dashboard data. Instead, a beautifully crafted empty state centered on the screen: 'Kompaniya qo'shish'. Generous padding (p-16), dashed border container, large Lucide 'Building' icon, clear descriptive text, and a primary action button. THIS IS CRITICAL FOR FIRST-TIME EXPERIENCE.
layouts.data_tables: Dense. text-sm. Use sticky headers. Checkboxes for bulk actions. Action menu (three dots) on the right edge.

components.buttons: Shadcn standard. Primary uses Emerald/Forest Green. Secondary uses crisp white/black borders.
components.badges: Used extensively for Receipt Statuses and Role badges (Creator, Admin, Observer). Must use the specific status colors defined above.
components.ai_chat: Not a generic chatbot. A structural, professional sidebar or split-pane. When AI reasoning or tool calling happens, show it as an accordion or muted mono-text block (e.g., '> Fetching Soliq Data...'). Must prompt for confirmation before financial actions.
components.forms: Strict Shadcn forms. Inputs must have clear focus states (ring-2 ring-emerald-500).
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for adding companies, matching products, and editing AI rules. Ensure modals have solid backgrounds (no transparent backgrounds).

motion.transitions: Fast, strictly structural. transition-colors duration-150. No bouncy animations.
motion.lists: Staggered fade-in for receipt tables and product lists.
motion.ai_typing: Subtle blinking cursor and fast token stream. No delays.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA. Ensure white text on Emerald has enough contrast.
accessibility.focus: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Every button, tab, and form input MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='add-company-btn'`, `data-testid='company-switcher-dropdown'`).

domain_specific_rules.language: Uzbek (Latin script). Use correct terminology: Kompaniya, Cheklar, Mahsulotlar, Mappinglar, Qoidalar, AI Yordamchi, Auditlar.
domain_specific_rules.creator_panel: Visually distinct settings area for the 'Creator' (Owner). Use a slightly different sidebar tint or a 'System Settings' header to denote elevated privileges. Includes AI Knowledge base CRUD.
domain_specific_rules.product_matching: UI must support side-by-side comparison: [Soliq Product / MXIK] <--> [1C Product Catalog]. Use a drag-and-drop or simple select mapping interface.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: DO NOT apply universal transition: all. Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Text aligns left for natural reading flow, especially for financial data.
Use 2-3x more spacing for empty states, but keep data tables tight and dense.
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use lucide-react icons for fallbacks.
Prioritize existing Shadcn UI components in src/components/ui.
